identity.title: POCUS lung: >=3 B-lines per intercostal space in >=2 bilateral zones (interstitial syndrome)

technique.how: Curvilinear or phased-array probe, longitudinal, depth ~12-16 cm, scanning 4-8 anterior-lateral zones per hemithorax (e.g., 8-zone Volpicelli). Count laser-like vertical artifacts arising from the pleural line that reach the screen bottom, erase A-lines and move with sliding; a zone is positive with >=3 B-lines, the study positive with >=2 positive zones bilaterally.
technique.prerequisites: Semi-recumbent or supine patient; hold each clip 3-5 s.

interpretation.positive_finding: Bilateral diffuse B-lines (positive Volpicelli criteria) indicate interstitial syndrome; in a dyspneic patient this favors cardiogenic pulmonary edema (pooled sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.90 vs expert diagnosis), with lung sliding preserved.
interpretation.negative_finding: A predominantly A-line (dry) anterior pattern makes cardiogenic edema unlikely and shifts the differential to COPD/asthma, PE or early pneumonia.
interpretation.pitfalls: B-lines are nonspecific: pneumonia, ARDS, ILD/fibrosis and chronic kidney disease volume overload also produce them; focal/unilateral or asymmetric B-lines with irregular pleura suggest pneumonia or ILD. Thresholds (>=2 vs >=3 B-lines, number of zones) vary across studies.
interpretation.changes_what: Bilateral B-lines: treat as pulmonary edema/volume overload (diuresis, dialysis timing) while confirming with echo/BNP. Absent: look for airway, embolic or focal causes.

estimates.target_condition: Acute decompensated heart failure / cardiogenic pulmonary edema
estimates.population: 1,827 adults presenting with dyspnea; 6 prospective cohorts (4 ED, 2 internal medicine); operators ranged from single experts to multiple emergency physicians with >=50 supervised exams
estimates.reference_standard: Expert clinical diagnosis by medical record review or echocardiography + BNP criteria
estimates.computed_from: LR+ = 0.88/(1-0.90); LR- = (1-0.88)/0.90 from pooled sens 0.88, spec 0.90 (Maw 2019 abstract); CIs not computed
estimates.quote: Pooled estimates for LUS were 0.88 (95% Cl, 0.75-0.95) for sensitivity and 0.90 (95% Cl, 0.88-0.92) for specificity.
estimates.location: Abstract, Results; thresholds per study in Table 1 (PMC6484641)

estimates.target_condition: Pulmonary edema as cause of acute respiratory failure (B profile: multiple anterior diffuse B lines with lung sliding)
estimates.population: 260 ICU patients with acute respiratory failure; pulmonary edema n=64; expert intensivist operator
estimates.quote: Multiple anterior diffuse B lines with lung sliding indicated pulmonary edema (n=64) with 97% sensitivity and 95% specificity.

sources.citation: Maw AM, Hassanin A, Ho PM, et al. Diagnostic Accuracy of Point-of-Care Lung Ultrasonography and Chest Radiography in Adults With Symptoms Suggestive of Acute Decompensated Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis. JAMA Netw Open. 2019;2(3):e190703.
Lichtenstein DA, Meziere GA. Relevance of lung ultrasound in the diagnosis of acute respiratory failure: the BLUE protocol. Chest. 2008;134(1):117-125.

safety_scope.do_not_use_when: Do not attribute B-lines to heart failure without clinical context in patients with known ILD, pneumonia/ARDS or after recent fluid resuscitation.
safety_scope.escalation_warning: Bilateral B-lines with hypotension or hypoxemia refractory to oxygen suggests cardiogenic shock or ARDS; escalate to critical care.
safety_scope.interobserver_note: Interrater reliability in Maw 2019 included studies ranged from kappa 0.94 (0.89-0.98) to 1.0 (Table 1); reliability is lower for novice operators and borderline counts.
safety_scope.skill_assumption: Operator trained in a multi-zone lung protocol (e.g., 8-zone Volpicelli or BLUE points), able to distinguish B-lines from Z-lines/comet tails and assess pleural line regularity.

extraction_notes: Pooled sens/spec quoted from Maw 2019 abstract; Table 1 (PMC OA) confirms all included studies used the Volpicelli criteria (>=3 B-lines in >=2 zones bilaterally) or a modification (some >=2 B-lines). LRs computed from pooled point estimates. BLUE prevalence computed as 64/260; BLUE CIs not in abstract. Hemodialysis/cardiorenal-specific accuracy not extracted within budget.
